welcome_console.subject: Welcome to Quelora Console
welcome_console.title: Welcome to Quelora!
welcome_console.intro: Your account has been successfully created by an administrator.
welcome_console.security_notice: Security Notice: Your temporary password will be shared with you separately by your administrator via a secure channel. You will be required to change it upon your first login.
welcome_console.login_instruction: You can log in to the console using the button below once you receive your credentials.

email_verification.subject: Verify your email – Quelora
email_verification.title: Confirm your email address
email_verification.intro: Use the verification code below to confirm your email address and complete your registration.
email_verification.ignore: If you did not create a Quelora account, you can safely ignore this message.

password_recovery.subject: Password Recovery – Quelora
password_recovery.title: Reset your password
password_recovery.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Quelora Console account. Use the code below to proceed.
password_recovery.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this message.
